CHAPTER 4 · ITEM 07 / 10

Equilibrium and changing markets

Shortage and surplus短缺與過剩

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Identify a shortage (Qd > Qs) or surplus (Qs > Qd) at a stated price and explain the usual pressure on price in an unrestricted market.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

低於均衡價時 Qd>Qs，有升價壓力；高於均衡價時 Qs>Qd，有降價壓力。短缺或過剩是意欲買賣數量的差額。

Below equilibrium, Qd exceeds Qs and buyers compete for scarce supply, creating upward price pressure. Above equilibrium, Qs exceeds Qd and unsold stock creates downward pressure. A shortage or surplus is a difference between desired quantities.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：At P=8, Qd=30 and Qs=18. Shortage=12; unrestricted price tends upward. 短缺十二單位。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

At a given price Qs=50, Qd=35. What pressure occurs? 供五十、需三十五？
